contents.label: Wonder Flowers and highly varied Wonder Effects

gameplayPillars.title: Wonder Effects
gameplayPillars.description: Touch a Wonder Flower and the course can transform dramatically: pipes move, perspectives change, enemies multiply and entirely new rules appear.

gameplayPillars.title: Badges and power-ups
gameplayPillars.description: Equip badges that alter movement or provide assistance, while new power-ups such as Elephant Fruit create new interactions.

gameplayPillars.title: Share the adventure
gameplayPillars.description: Up to four people can play on one system, and online features add live player ghosts, standees and cooperative assistance.

worldSummary: The adventure takes place in the Flower Kingdom, made up of six main worlds plus the Petal Isles. Bowser uses a Wonder Flower to merge with Prince Florian's castle, while Mario and friends travel across varied regions collecting Wonder Seeds.

storyChapters.title: The Flower Kingdom
storyChapters.body: Prince Florian welcomes Mario and friends before Bowser transforms the castle into a flying fortress.

storyChapters.title: Six worlds and Petal Isles
storyChapters.body: The heroes cross colorful regions, finding Wonder Seeds and confronting Bowser Jr. in multiple palaces.

storyChapters.title: Castle Bowser
storyChapters.body: The journey culminates in the transformed castle and the final effort to free the Flower Kingdom.

faq.q: Does the original Switch version support four players?
faq.a: Yes. Up to four players can play locally on one Nintendo Switch system.

faq.q: What resolution and frame rate does it use?
faq.a: The original Switch version targets 60 fps, with 1080p docked and 720p handheld gameplay.

faq.q: Can this version be upgraded on Switch 2?
faq.a: Yes. Nintendo sells a Switch 2 Edition upgrade pack that adds enhanced graphics and Bellabel Park content.

verdictSummary: A benchmark modern 2D platformer: inventive without abandoning Mario's immediate controls, full of surprises, and technically excellent on the original Switch.
verdictCons: Online interaction is cooperative rather than traditional matchmaking
Some characters intentionally remove damage challenge
